preconditions.description: Number of vertices (N) and number of queries (Q) are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges are between valid vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for v, x in update_queries)
preconditions.description: All update queries have valid vertex and value.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for v in query_vertices)
preconditions.description: All query vertices are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(result % (10**9 + 7) == expected_result for result, expected_result in zip(results, expected_results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v, modulo 10^9+7.
